legacy_marginal.sampling_assumption: Certification observations are independent and identically distributed image-level units from the nominal population; thresholds are fixed on a disjoint tuning subset.

familywise_portfolio.interpretation: With probability at least 1 - delta over the certification sample, every certified (policy, gate) pair satisfies both population targets; selecting the max-coverage certified pair is therefore covered by the same statement.

familywise_tuning_selected.interpretation: Policy selection is measurable with respect to the tuning role; the fixed-sequence certificate for the selected policy therefore holds at the full joint level delta.
